messages:
ana: quick sync — we need to rebalance the launch lanes for the apr pilot. two competing customer asks (acme wants early sso + telemetry, beta pilot needs tenant routing + embeddings cache). we can't realistically ship everything for alpha. thoughts?

sam: prioritize acme's sso. procurement is blocked until they see SAML SSO. :grimacing:

jess: is acme strictly SAML? that's ~2 dev sprints if we do full org-level SAML + audit.

tara: proposal: split lanes — alpha (ship core + SSO for acme), beta (tenant routing + cache) pushed to v1. keeps alpha low-latency and reduces blast radius.

ben: agree on lanes. embeddings cache might actually be a small lift if we enable an opt-in cache and toggle it behind a flag. cheaper than routing.

ana: (typo) ana: tradeoff list for PM/Eng: SSO = blockers from legal/infra + QA (+3 weeks risk), tenant routing = medium infra work + policy changes, embeddings cache = small infra + can be feature-flagged.

jess: could we do minimal SAML (SP-initiated only) for alpha and postpone IdP discovery and SCIM? that would cut effort.

sam: legal said acme needs audit evidence later but will accept a canary SP-only flow for initial demo. so minimal SAML ok as long as we document the gaps.

deploy-bot: Heads up — release window freeze scheduled 1787655000 -> 1787658600. plan accordingly.

ana: copying decision matrix i'm thinking:```
- SSO (Acme): Blocker for their procurement -> alpha lane (canary SAML, no SCIM)
- Tenant routing (Beta): Important for multi-tenant pilot -> defer to v1
- Embeddings cache: Low-risk perf win -> opt-in feature flag in alpha, full rollout in v1
```

ana: proposed owners and next steps: jess = SSO deliverable (estimate by EOD fri), ben = cache PoC (toggle + metrics, estimate by Tue), mike = tenant routing spike (scoping only, no rollout timeline yet). ana will update roadmap and notify sales/customer success.

jess: ack — starting spike today, will post estimate in this thread. :thumbsup:

ben: ack, I'll prototype the cache interface and validate perf impact on dev infra.

mike: ack on the spike. will surface any major infra/dependency needs.

sam: i'll coordinate with acme on the SAML checklist and timeline.

tara: sounds good. please add a short rollback/fallback plan in the SSO PR: how we disable if things fail.

ana: agreed. i'll add canary gates and a rollback play in the ticket. updating roadmap doc: https://redwood.example.com/roadmap/launch-lanes (internal link) :sparkles:

jess: quick q — do we want a hard date for beta -> v1, or keep it metrics-driven?

ana: metrics-driven. primary signals: acme procurement signed, failed login rate <0.2% on canary, latency impacts <10% p50. if all good, we accelerate beta work into the next milestone.

sam: noted. i'll track procurement as the gating signal.

ana: thanks everyone — i'll capture this in the milestone tracker and assign tasks. next sync if any of the owners hit blockers.

ben: +1

jess: +1

mike: +1

(END)
